summary.en: Another day, another case as Kogoro stumbles upon the death of the President of a popular apparel company. Just why would the President be wearing an unflattering facial mask if she had been expecting company? It's just one of the many perplexing elements of a most unusual case. Location: Kojima household Victim: Ikuko Kojima Cause of death: Manual strangulation Suspects: Takeo Izumi, Chihiro Kojima, and Juro Yoshioka
